Notification of Transactions of Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities ("PDMRs")

The Company announces that deferred share awards granted to Iain Hooley, originally due to vest in March and June 2026, vested on 16 October 2026. The vesting of the awards were delayed pending completion of the FCA Skilled Person Review.
The notification below, which has been made in accordance with the requirements of the UK Market Abuse Regulation, provides further detail.
Notification and public disclosure of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities and persons closely associated with them.

Details of the transaction(s): section to be repeated for (i) each type of instrument; (ii) each type of transaction; (iii) each date; and (iv) each place where transactions have been conducted
Description of the financial instrument, type of instrument

The deferred share awards were transferred to the Executive Director at nil cost (the "Vested Shares"). Sufficient vested shares were sold to satisfy the tax and NIC liabilities arising in connection with the vesting.
